DebugMode.Name: Debug Mode
DebugMode.Hint: Log trigger detection details to the console.

ChatReminders.Name: Chat Reminders
ChatReminders.Hint: Whisper a reminder to an ability's owner when its trigger condition may have occurred.

SpentTracking.Name: Track Triggered Actions
SpentTracking.Hint: Track when a combatant spends their triggered action and stop reminding them about non-free triggers until the next round.

RollLock.Name: Roll Lock
RollLock.Hint: Hold ability rolls while triggered abilities that could interrupt them wait for a Use or Decline decision. Only applies during combat.

DamagePrompts.Name: Damage Prompts
DamagePrompts.Hint: When a creature takes damage, dies, or becomes winded, matching triggered abilities appear in the Trigger Stack with Use and Decline instead of a chat reminder.

DamageInterrupts.Name: Damage Interrupts
DamageInterrupts.Hint: Hold incoming damage before it lands when the target or an ally has a triggered ability that modifies it, such as halving. The Director confirms the final amount after triggers resolve. Only applies during combat.

StackDecisionTimer.Name: Stack Decision Timer
StackDecisionTimer.Hint: Triggers on the stack auto-decline after the Roll Lock Grace Period elapses with no decision. Choosing Use grants the rest of the group fresh time.

RollLockGrace.Name: Roll Lock Grace Period
RollLockGrace.Hint: After Use is chosen for a triggered ability, the held roll resumes when that ability's message is posted, or after this many seconds if it never posts (for cancelled flows).

Detail.Manual: This trigger was configured by hand and skips the parser.
Detail.MaliceImplicit: Malice feature: offered at the start of the creature's turn.
Detail.Unrecognized: The parser could not confidently read this trigger. Reminders only.
Detail.EventNeedsTier: {event}: needs a compatibility tier to detect.
Detail.ScopeNeedsTier: Scope {scope}: needs a compatibility tier to resolve.
Detail.Revisit: Marked for a later revisit; not detected yet.
Detail.DsctOnly: Needs Draw Steel: Combat Tools data to detect.

Editor.Title: Trigger Builder: {name}
Editor.OpenTooltip: Open the trigger builder to override how this trigger is automated.
Editor.NoTriggerText: This ability has no trigger text.
Editor.OwnerUnacted: Only if this creature has not acted this round
Editor.AnyHeroUnacted: Only while any hero has not acted this round
Editor.EventHint: What has to happen in play for this trigger to fire.
Editor.ScopeHint: Who the event must happen to, from this ability's owner's point of view.
Editor.QualifiersHint: Extra conditions from the trigger text, shown in reminders. Not yet enforced automatically.
Editor.DamageTypesHint: For damage events only: fire the trigger just for these damage types. None selected means any type.
Editor.AbilityDsidHint: Only fire when the causing ability's Draw Steel ID matches, e.g. gore.
Editor.GroupNameHint: For the Group scope: the event must happen to a creature with this keyword (or this word in its name).
Editor.ChecksHint: Availability gates checked at the moment the event happens.
Editor.MaliceHint: Malice actions are offered to the Director on the acting creature's turn and never spend a triggered action.
Editor.SaveHint: Stores this configuration on the ability and stops using the automatic parser.
Editor.ResetHint: Deletes the override and returns this ability to the automatic parser.

Queue.Title: Trigger Stack

Cause.POWER_ROLL: Triggered by {roller} making a power roll ({ability}).
Cause.TARGETED_BY_STRIKE: Triggered by {roller} targeting {owner} with a strike ({ability}).

Queue.ReleaseTooltip: Resume the held ability immediately (Director only). Undecided triggers become simple prompts.
Queue.ApplyNowTooltip: Apply the held damage immediately (Director only). Undecided triggers become simple prompts.
Queue.HeldDamageCause: Triggered by {name} being dealt {amount} damage. The damage is held.
Queue.HeldDamageNotice: {name}'s damage is held while triggered abilities are decided. See the Trigger Stack.
Queue.HeldDamageHint: A triggered ability was used against this damage. Adjust the original {amount} to the final amount, then apply.
Queue.HeldDamageDiscarded: Held damage for {name} discarded. No Stamina was changed.
Queue.RollHeld: {name} is held while triggered abilities are decided. See the Trigger Stack.

MaliceCard.Title: {name}'s Malice
MaliceCard.Intro: At the start of {name}'s turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.

Reminder.Speaker: Draw Steel: Triggers
Reminder.ImplicitMaliceTrigger: Available at the start of this creature's turn.
Reminder.LinkTooltip: Click to use this ability. Shift-click to share its description to chat.
Reminder.Dies: Triggered by {name} being reduced to 0 Stamina.
